title: Ritual of Time's Threshold
text: Requires one Advanced Ritual Energy Core, eight Crystal Pedestals, four Spacetime Knots, two Paradox Dust and two Infused Spiritual Crystals. Lure a Dream Mirror nearby, keep the space above the core clear, then use an Unstable Spacetime Aggregate on the core.

After twelve seconds the aggregate is consumed and a three-minute gateway opens. Use a Spacetime Spell Core instead for a permanent gateway. Pedestal offerings remain. Dismantling during formation ejects the activator; an aggregate may trigger a storm.

Both gateway types require their core, pedestals and offerings. Dismantling or removing offerings closes the gateway and releases the Dream Mirror. Stay near its surface briefly to enter. Ordinary vehicles may carry passengers through; large mechanical structures cannot.

Outside spacetime, gateways reach the Mirror Corridor, whose rifts lead to the Time Continent or Space Caverns without a return rift. Within spacetime, gateways reach your valid Overworld respawn point, falling back to world spawn.
